reason: These 87 cases are about invented companies (Acme Corp, Beta Inc, Northstar Health) and were labelled by one author. An agreement number, a false-pass rate, a knowledge-applicability score or a backtest gate computed on them says nothing about real accounts, so no metric, benchmark or backtest reads them any more.
replacement: bench/data/account_split.json: real CRMArena-Pro B2B accounts, an account-level split with a demo partition that is never gold. Reference answers come from a different, stronger model (see gold_source there), not from humans.
allowed_use: pipeline mechanics only: schema checks, cassette replay and matcher regression tests that say so. Never an agreement, false-pass, false-block, backtest or knowledge-applicability number.
